description: This file defines the Subscription class within the Opencart.Admin.Model.Sale namespace. It provides various methods for managing sale subscriptions in an OpenCart e-commerce system, including editing subscriptions, payment details, subscription plans, remaining periods, date updates, and retrieving subscription data.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Represents the subscription model allowing management of customer subscriptions in the admin sale module.

methods.name: editSubscription
methods.description: Updates the subscription plan and customer payment ID for a given subscription ID.

methods.name: editPaymentMethod
methods.description: Updates the payment method for a specific subscription.

methods.name: editSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Modifies the subscription plan associated with a subscription ID.

methods.name: editRemaining
methods.description: Changes the remaining period for a subscription.

methods.name: editTrialRemaining
methods.description: Updates the trial period remaining for a subscription.

methods.name: editDateNext
methods.description: Sets a new date for the next scheduled subscription payment.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionByCustomerPaymentId
methods.description: Removes a subscription record based on the customer payment ID.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves subscription data by subscription ID.

methods.name: getSubscriptionByOrderProductId
methods.description: Fetches a subscription associated with specific order ID and order product ID.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Returns a list of subscriptions matching filter criteria, including details from related orders.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptions
methods.description: Calculates the total number of subscriptions based on filter criteria.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionsByStoreId
methods.description: Counts subscriptions for a specific store ID.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionsBySubscriptionStatusId
methods.description: Counts subscriptions with a specific subscription status ID.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a history record for subscription status changes, comments, and notifications.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Inserts a new history record for a specified subscription ID, updating its status, optional comment, and notification flag.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of subscription history entries, including date added, status, comment, and notification flag.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns the total number of history entries for a specific subscription.

methods.name: getTotalHistoriesBySubscriptionStatusId
methods.description: Counts all history entries with a particular subscription status ID.
